name: Soukyuu no Cradle -Ningyou Gakuen Choukyouki-
original_name: 蒼穹のクレイドル －人形学園調教記－
source:
Let's embark on an adventure journey to become the strongest puppeteer in a world in which people who are absolutely obedient to human beings called magical dolls (Aion) and who obey any command are generalized!

Implemented a polite tutorial and system explanation from the beginning! On top of a game system centered on free upbringing and strengthening, a solid story about the origin of the magical doll Aion and the puppeteer is also developed!

We have also prepared a "lively" game story that is well matched to the system that users have strongly requested in past titles!

[From the [url=http://lunasoft.jp/product/lus003/about.html]official website[/url]]
